title: Beyond SFT-to-RL: Pre-alignment via Black-Box On-Policy Distillation for Multimodal RL
abstract: arXiv:2604.28123v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The standard post-training recipe for large multimodal models (LMMs) applies supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on curated demonstrations followed by reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). However, SFT introduces distributional drift that neither preserves the model's original capabilities nor faithfully matches the supervision distribution. This problem is further amplified in multimodal reasoning, where perception errors and reasoning failures follow distinct drift patterns that compound during subsequent RL. translated_title: 超越SFT到RL：基于黑盒在线策略蒸馏的多模态强化学习预对齐
translated_abstract: 大型多模态模型（LMMs）的标准后训练方案是在精心筛选的演示数据上进行监督微调（SFT），随后进行带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）。然而，SFT引入了分布偏移，既无法保留模型的原始能力，也无法忠实地匹配监督分布。这一问题在多模态推理中被进一步放大，因为感知错误和推理失败遵循不同的漂移模式，并在后续强化学习过程中相互叠加。我们提出了PRISM，一个三阶段流水线，通过在SFT和RLVR之间插入显式的分布对齐阶段来缓解这种漂移。基于在线策略蒸馏（OPD）的原理，PRISM将对齐过程建模为策略与一个配备专门感知和推理专家的混合专家判别器（MoE）之间的黑盒、响应级对抗博弈，从而提供解耦的修正信号……
tldr: 提出PRISM三阶段流水线，通过黑盒在线策略蒸馏的对抗博弈，在SFT与RLVR之间插入显式分布对齐阶段，缓解监督微调引起的分布偏移对多模态强化学习的损害。
en_tdlr: PRISM is a three-stage pipeline that inserts an explicit distribution-alignment stage between SFT and RLVR, framing alignment as a black-box response-level adversarial game with an MoE discriminator to mitigate distributional drift in multimodal RL.
